description: This file contains initialization routines for full C support on ARM Cortex-M architecture within Zephyr OS, including vector table relocation, FPU setup, zeroing BSS, copying data, and starting C execution.

methods.name: relocate_vector_table
methods.description: Relocates the vector table based on architecture configuration, either by setting the VTOR register or copying the vector table to a specific address.

methods.name: z_arm_floating_point_init
methods.description: Initializes the ARM FPU, setting access permissions and FP status registers based on configuration.

methods.name: z_prep_c
methods.description: Prepares the system for C code execution by relocating vector table, initializing FPU, zeroing BSS, copying data, initializing interrupts, and calling z_cstart.
